0.query:
fetch logs
| filter in(outsystems.log.type, "Integration", "ServiceAPI")
| filter isNotNull(outsystems.api.endpoint)
| summarize Count = count(), by: {Endpoint = outsystems.api.endpoint, Direction = outsystems.api.direction}
| sort Count desc
| limit 10

1.query:
fetch logs
| filter in(outsystems.log.type, "Integration", "ServiceAPI")
| filter isNotNull(outsystems.api.endpoint)
| summarize AvgResponseTime = avg(toLong(outsystems.api.response_time)), by: {Endpoint = outsystems.api.endpoint}
| sort AvgResponseTime desc
| limit 10

2.query:
fetch logs
| filter in(outsystems.log.type, "Integration", "ServiceAPI")
| filter isNotNull(outsystems.api.endpoint)
| summarize TotalCount = count(), ErrorCount = countIf(isNotNull(outsystems.log.error.uid)), by: {Endpoint = outsystems.api.endpoint}
| fieldsAdd ErrorRate = round((ErrorCount / TotalCount) * 100, decimals:2)
| filter ErrorCount > 0
| sort ErrorRate desc
| limit 10
